case_title: Narayan Manikrao Salgar v. State of Maharashtra
mitigating_circumstances: Accused intended to teach a lesson, not to kill
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of all charges except accused Nos. 9 and 11
neutral_facts: The accused and others assaulted the victim, resulting in severe injuries. Two eyewitnesses testified to the incident, and the victim provided a dying declaration. Blood-stained items and weapons were recovered. The victim sustained multiple contused and lacerated wounds, along with fractures, leading to his death. The medical evidence indicated the injuries were caused by blunt objects. The prosecution argued the assault was premeditated, but the court found the accused did not share a common object of causing murder. The accused were convicted under Section 326/149 IPC and sentenced to seven years of rigorous imprisonment.
